name: Voice Cloning
objectives: Clone a target voice from a short reference sample only after a verified consent record exists
Produce speech output in the cloned voice from arbitrary input text
Watermark every generated audio file for provenance
tasks: Validate a signed consent record against the reference audio hash before any cloning run
Refuse a subject who is not confirmed to be an adult
Run local TTS cloning only when the packages and weights are installed on the user's machine
Refuse to write audio when the watermark library is missing
benchmarks: Speaker similarity score against the reference sample
Watermark library missing blocks the write
safety_constraints: Never clone a voice without a verified consent record tied to the exact reference audio
Never process reference audio of a minor
Reject a paid run on the non-commercial XTTS backend
Every output file must carry a provenance watermark before it is written
